assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create one production game background asset for Jianghu, an original Chinese Song-dynasty wuxia dialogue visual novel. Landscape 16:9 composition, traditional refined Chinese ink wash and watercolor on warm rice paper. A small sword-training courtyard at the foot of Mount Hua, misty mountains behind pine trees, weathered cream plaster walls, restrained dark green roof tiles, old wooden veranda on the right, flat wet pale stone paving and a narrow red cloth tied to a branch. Cool early morning, quiet tension, soft smoky sage ink mountains, ivory paper, muted ochre and one small cinnabar accent. The LEFT and CENTER foreground must be open pale paving with plenty of clean negative space for independently rendered character half-body illustrations; mountains and roof occupy upper half. Fine illustrative quality, expressive authentic brush edges, elegant painterly depth and atmospheric perspective, believable Song-era architecture. No people, no swords in foreground, NO words or letters, NO user interface, NO dialogue box, no watermark, no anime, no neon, no ornate palace. This is scenery only, all game controls are real HTML rendered elsewhere.
assets.conversion: FFmpeg libwebp, scenery q88, cast q90; preserved alpha; no image text or controls

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a single cohesive CAST SHEET asset for a refined Song-dynasty Chinese wuxia visual novel named Jianghu. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Wide landscape composition with three distinct half-body characters in THREE EQUALLY WIDE COLUMNS, left at exactly one-sixth canvas width, middle at one-half, right at five-sixths, each fully isolated with generous transparent gaps, none of their arms/hair/clothing crossing column boundaries. Frame each from top of head to below waist, all three at the same head height and portrait scale. LEFT: Lin Jianwei, a young Chinese woman swordswoman, around 23, intelligent and self-possessed, black hair tied in a high practical bun with slender red tie, ivory crossed-collar inner robe and muted dark jade-green sleeveless outer robe, cinnabar waist sash, gently skeptical raised eyebrow, one hand resting on sheathed sword by hip, looks slightly toward the center. MIDDLE: Xie Linchuan, a young Chinese man around 25, black tied hair, expressive handsome face, proud but slightly worried, simple blue-gray traditional Song-era crossed-collar traveling robe, brown sash, holds a plain practice sword vertically below shoulder level, looks slightly toward left. RIGHT: Wen Zheng, Chinese elderly local sword instructor around 67, lean lined face, gray hair in neat topknot, short gray beard, charcoal moss-green robe, relaxed knowing half-smile, hands behind back, no mystical aura. Consistent sophisticated traditional Chinese ink wash and editorial watercolor, clearly legible attractive facial features, finely controlled brushwork and elegant painted cloth folds, limited low saturation jade green, ivory, slate and cinnabar accents, not anime, not photorealistic, no giant costume fantasy armor, no caricature, no heads cropped. Clean true transparent alpha around the actual silhouettes. No ground, no scenery, no border, NO TEXT OR LABELS, no UI, no watermark. All expressions and names are implemented separately in HTML. One sheet, three separate complete silhouettes evenly spaced.
assets.conversion: FFmpeg libwebp, scenery q88, cast q90; preserved alpha; no image text or controls
